issue.title: Run bob ref jobs run -q from the Mac 15-minute schedule

task_type_fields.proposal: Run `bob ref jobs run -q` from the Mac's 15-minute schedule, next to the existing `bob ref scan` job (the chezmoi-managed Mac crontab). That drains ref jobs a capture kick left behind: the worker failed to spawn, the Mac rebooted or slept mid-clip, or a stale running/ job needs recovery. The worker is single-flight (non-blocking worker.lock) and exits 0 when another worker runs, so a cron run is safe. Ordering it before `bob ref scan` lets newly clipped PDFs become ref notes in the same cycle. Update docs/ref-jobs.md, which today says only kicks start the worker.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-52 relies on a detached kick after each capture and kept scheduler changes out of scope; its verify phase proposed this as a follow-up (bob-cli-52.9 note #5). The Mac crontab lives in the chezmoi repo, not bob-cli.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52's ref jobs depend on a detached kick; a scheduled single-flight drain catches jobs a failed kick or a reboot left behind (bob-cli-52.9 note #5).
